source.publication: 2025 Form MO-1040, Form MO-A and Form MO-1040 Instructions (Missouri Department of Revenue); 2025 Missouri Income Tax Reference Guide (Form 4711)
source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Instructions PDF p7 Line 7 income percentages and combined return; PDF p21 'A separate tax must be computed for you and your spouse'; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section B Lines 1-9; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9; record private_pension_subtraction; projection income_test.reduce_each_person false

worked: Married filing combined (joint federal), ages 60 and 62. Both spouses have private pensions and income is over the limit: Section B Line 9 takes the one excess once off the spouses' total (Line 8), so the projection sets reduce_each_person false and reduces the return's total once. Taking 8,000 off each spouse's 6,000 would leave nothing. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 28,000.00 + pensions 12,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 8,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 40,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 40,000.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 40,000.00 - 0.00 = 40,000.00. Section B: Line 1 40,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 40,000.00; Line 4 32,000.00; Line 5 8,000.00; Line 6Y 6,000.00, Line 7Y 6,000.00; Line 6S 6,000.00, Line 7S 6,000.00; Line 8 12,000.00; Line 9 12,000.00 - 8,000.00 = 4,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 4,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 31,500.00. Line 26 subtotal 40,000.00 - 4,000.00 - 31,500.00 = 4,500.00. Line 29 taxable income 4,500.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,313.00 = 32.825 + 3% x 561.00 = 16.83; total 75.915 = 75.92. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 76; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 40,000.00 - Line 8 4,000.00 = 36,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 40,000.00. On the form itself Line 27 splits Line 26 by each spouse's share of Missouri AGI (34,000.00 and 6,000.00 of 40,000.00: 85% and 15%), 3,825.00 and 675.00, and the chart is used for each: 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,199.00 = 29.975, so 56.235, and 0.00 for the spouse; 56.24 in all (the chart gives 56). Expected follows the projection, which applies the chart once to 4,500.00 (accepted approximation).
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).

Married filing combined: Missouri figures a separate tax for each spouse on that spouse's share of taxable income, using the one chart twice, and this is required, not chosen. The projection applies the chart once to the couple's total taxable income, because the format has no way to say tax is per spouse.
